name: Prepare and verify a Java workspace
description: Create an IntelliJ Java project with the intended JDK, identify the source root, and run a saved class.

name: Explain source, compilation, and execution
description: Distinguish a .java source file, compiler feedback, bytecode, the JVM, a class, and a main entry point at beginner depth.

name: Read and repair early Java errors
description: Use IntelliJ/compiler messages, file and line evidence, and a stack trace to repair syntax, name, type, or runtime failures.

name: Represent values with Java types
description: Declare readable int, double, boolean, char, and String variables; distinguish primitives from references at beginner depth.

name: Read and convert console input
description: Use one Scanner deliberately, read text and numeric input without newline surprises, and parse numeric text when appropriate.

name: Compare Java values correctly
description: Use numeric comparisons, boolean operators, and String.equals instead of reference equality for text decisions.

name: Express ordered decisions
description: Use if/else-if/else in a deliberate order so invalid, boundary, and successful cases produce one explainable result.

name: Recover from invalid numeric text
description: Catch NumberFormatException only around the expected conversion boundary without hiding unrelated defects.

name: Repeat with progress and stopping rules
description: Use for and while loops, deliberate updates, break, and traceable stopping conditions without accidental infinite loops.

name: Process fixed arrays
description: Create, index, update, and traverse a fixed-length array while respecting zero-based boundaries.

name: Manage a growing ArrayList
description: Create a typed ArrayList, add/get/remove values, inspect size, and traverse without unsafe index changes.

name: Define focused static methods
description: Write static methods with purposeful names, parameters, return types, and one understandable responsibility.

name: Return and compose values
description: Return values rather than relying on incidental printing and combine focused methods into a larger result.

name: Reason about local scope and overloads
description: Keep local variables inside their method boundary and distinguish a changed argument list from a changed return type.

name: Create simple Java objects
description: Define a class, constructor, private instance fields, and independent instances with valid initial state.

name: Encapsulate object behavior
description: Expose focused methods that validate and change one object while preserving its invariants and unrelated instances.

name: Use object collections
description: Store typed objects in an ArrayList and query or summarize them through public methods.

name: Read and write UTF-8 text with Files
description: Use Path and Files with a stable project-relative location, explicit UTF-8, and predictable line records.

name: Handle file and conversion failures narrowly
description: Distinguish a missing first-run file, malformed stored record, and I/O failure without erasing existing data.

name: Debug one failing case in IntelliJ
description: Set a breakpoint, step through one reproducible failure, inspect local values, repair one cause, and rerun the same case.

name: Verify behavior with a dependency-free check harness
description: Run deterministic normal, boundary, and invalid cases through small check methods without adding a build framework.

name: Parse a small command-line contract
description: Read command-line arguments, validate command shape and values, and provide usable help without ambiguous input.

name: Document and publish a safe Java repository
description: Write reproducible JDK/IntelliJ/run instructions, inspect staged paths, commit locally, and push a secret-free project to GitHub.
